name: alert-dialog
title: Alert Dialog
description: A confirmation dialog for destructive actions. A trigger button opens a dark rounded panel on a dimmed page, showing a bold question, a warning paragraph, and Cancel next to a red confirm button.
use: An irreversible action needs an explicit yes, with the consequence spelled out first.
avoid: It depends on Radix and a separate button component, and its dark panel assumes a dark theme.
a11y: Focus trapping, Escape and labelled title and description come from the dialog primitive, but the zoom and fade ignore reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A soft red rounded button on a near-black page. Opening it shows a dark rounded panel with a thin border, holding a bold title, a short grey paragraph, and a right-aligned row of two buttons: an outlined Cancel and a pale red confirm.
behaves: Clicking the trigger fades a black overlay over the page and zooms the panel in slightly. Escape or Cancel dismisses it without acting; the red button confirms, closes and fires the action. Focus stays inside the panel while it is open.
customise: Each part is a separate composable piece, so you supply your own title, description and footer buttons and can override classes on the panel, overlay and header.
weight: light: A small portal panel with fade and zoom classes; nothing runs while it is idle.
usage:
